explanation: Early previews were shown after the main feature, trailing it, which gave them the name. Cinemas moved them to the start because many people left when the feature ended.

claims.text: A short preview that advertises a film is called a trailer.
A prologue opens a story, a montage is a sequence of edited shots, and credits list the people who made a film.
Trailers got their name because early ones were shown after the main feature.
Cinemas moved trailers to before the feature because many people left when the feature ended.
